Remark
[Polyhedral gluing counts] \group thurston-ch01-polyhedra Source: thurston:page-0011

The number of face-pairing patterns for an octahedron is \[ \frac{8!}{2^4\, 4!}\, 3^4=8505, \] and the corresponding count for an icosahedron is $38{,}661$ billion before quotienting by symmetries. Pairings of the sides of a $2n$-gon giving oriented surfaces number $(2n)!/(2^n n!)$; unlike in dimension three, the Euler characteristic completely classifies closed oriented surfaces.
